name: @vendoai-fixtures/context-e2e
description: Whole-chain context proof: Playwright Chromium drives the REAL demo-bank (Maple) app against a real model, with a tiny contextWindowTokens override so compaction, recall, hires, overflow recovery and cache growth all happen inside one browser session.

scripts.//pretest:browser: Maple's dev server resolves @vendoai/ui to its SOURCE (next.config.ts turbopack alias), and that source imports the gitignored jail runtime bundle. `build` generates it in a prebuild hook, but it lives under src/ and is not a declared turbo output, so a cached build leaves it missing — same reason the nightly voice leg builds it explicitly.
